title: The kbmon mod calls $.ui.notify when the needs-you line changes and names something
goal: the kbmon mod calls `$.ui.notify` with the needs-you line when that line changes between two refreshes of an interactive session and names something (not for the first reading of a session, an unchanged line or `nothing`); a `ui.notify` that rejects or answers `isSent: false` leaves the pane, the receipt and the next notification working

clauses.clause: the kbmon mod calls `$.ui.notify` with the needs-you line when that line changes between two refreshes of an interactive session and names something (not for the first reading of a session, an unchanged line or `nothing`)
a `ui.notify` that rejects or answers `isSent: false` leaves the pane, the receipt and the next notification working

gates.question: How does the kbmon mod get the whole needs-you line to notify, when kbmon.py --once cuts each row at the pane's width?
options: Run kbmon.py --status all (first line) only when the --once row changed or ends in an ellipsis
Run kbmon.py --status all on every refresh
gates.recommendation: Run kbmon.py --status all (first line) only when the --once row changed or ends in an ellipsis
gates.answer: Run kbmon.py --status all (first line) only when the --once row changed or ends in an ellipsis

notes: Premise: `claude plugin test` of a copy of .claude/skills/kbmon-pane with a planted test (stubbed process.run, ui.notify and the clock) fails on base: the line changes from nothing to a gate and `ui.notify` is called 0 times, expected 1 (check 0 prints it; check 1 the same). Facts: kb/public/claude/mods.md:113-115 (ui.notify answers {isSent, channel} or {isSent:false, reason} and rejects on a denying hook or a failed write; DOC S-sao3dfcq). Live docs, not in the kb (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/create and /test, read 2026-10-24): a hooks module imports only its own files by relative path, `$` passed to a function imported from another file fails `claude plugin validate`, so the notify call stays in register.tsx in a top-level function that takes `$`; `claude plugin test` (a *.test.ts under the mod's directory, run with the real claude binary, not the PATH wrapper that adds --settings) is the planted run; check 0 also runs `claude plugin validate` and needs `$.ui.notify` in its calls line. Plan 2026-10-24 (night run): the 'needs you' row of `kbmon.py --once` (or the first line of `kbmon.py --status all`) is the line; the mod sends it prefixed `needs you: ` (the row is already redacted by kbmon); the first reading of a session is the baseline (like the receipt toast, which skips the first), `nothing` is never sent; a rejected call is caught and the next change is tried again. The register.tsx file is a protected path: edit a staging copy and finish with `stage-back`. A real session shows the notification only with a terminal channel in preferredNotifChannel; the planted run stubs it. Filed 2026-10-24 (night run) as one of the three later stories EP-nij36lt7 names; approved by the operator.
